svg.text: Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Primary AD domain: lab.example.test. APP01 is the member-server pilot; a cloud identity is
separate from this AD domain unless you deliberately configure it.
Record each private IP, OS version, agent state and an approved backup. Open the VMware console
before response exercises so you can recover a guest even if its network is isolated.
Do not put a public IP on your practice servers or open inbound RDP to the internet for these
exercises. Azure Arc uses outbound service connectivity; it does not move the VM into Azure.
Check: Your pilot and recovery method are named before security changes.
